The *Pītittika, Hetuduka* (Patthana 16.31) is an Abhidhamma text situated within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As designated by its title, the text treats the analytical intersection of the triad related to rapture or zest (*pītittika*) with the dyad on causal roots (*hetuduka*), examining their conditional relations within the broader matrix of conditional causality characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna* [SuttaCentral].
